notes: Shared logical agents. Edit behavior in the referenced role files; host discovery, models and permissions belong to adapters.

agents.description: Classifies tasks, sequences specialists, checks acceptance criteria and owns the user-facing result.
Analyzes consequential design, module boundaries, contracts, persistence and operational impact before Heavy implementation.
Clarifies product intent and testable acceptance criteria when requirements are materially uncertain.
Implements authorized Medium or Heavy changes using established patterns and reports checks for Verifier.
Implements small, fully specified Light changes; reports to Coordinator if scope or risk grows.
Captures baseline and post-edit build/test evidence; reports exact commands, results and limitations without editing source.
Independently reviews Heavy or explicitly requested changes for concrete defects, risks and verification gaps.
Performs explicitly scoped Mechanical changes and reports when work stops being mechanical.
